Master Materials

Five Mediums. Zero Compromise.

Each material demands its own heating temperature, tooling speed, and protective coating. Here is how we engineer each alloy in our Ludhiana workshop.

01. Wrought Iron 02. Stainless Steel 03. Aluminium Pergolas 04. Wood & Metal 05. Aluminium Work
Chapter 01

Wrought Iron & Heavy Mild Steel

For monumental driveway gates, boundary perimeter railings, and fortress-grade window grills. We use thick-gauge IS 2062 structural mild steel rather than the thin lightweight hollow pipes common in speculative market construction.

IS 2062 Grade A Structural Steel Hand-Forged Scrollwork & Finials Zinc Phosphate Anti-Corrosion Primer Italian PU Satin & Blackened Patina

Typical Applications: Automated sliding gates, ornamental double-leaf driveway gates, security grill lattices, balcony balustrades, and heavy industrial warehouse shutters.

Chapter 02

Stainless Steel & Mono-Stringers

Precision TIG argon-shielded fabrication for ultra-modern residential staircases, glass balustrades, and structural steel centerpieces. We eliminate ugly visible screws and rattling glass brackets by engineering continuous mechanical locks.

Certified SS 304 / Marine SS 316 High-Argon TIG Welds 400-Grit Satin Hairline or Mirror Polish Solid Brass Accent Interlocks

Typical Applications: Mono-stringer straight and curved staircases, frameless glass channel railings, outdoor terrace balustrades, and brass-inlaid handrails.

Chapter 03

Architectural Aluminium & Laser Facades

High-tensile aluminium gives you zero corrosion even after decades of harsh monsoons and intense sun. Perfect for rooftop pergolas, louvered weather canopies, and CNC laser-perforated architectural facade panels.

6063-T6 High Strength Extrusions Fiber Laser CNC Precision Cutting AkzoNobel 15-Year Exterior Powder Coat Integrated Rain Water Channels

Typical Applications: Rooftop glass pergolas, modern motorized exterior louvers, CNC jaali privacy screens for bungalows, and lightweight boundary wall cladding.

Chapter 04

Solid Hardwood & Metal Interlock

The warmth of natural seasoned timber meets the unbending strength of cold-rolled steel. We combine kiln-dried Burma and CP Teakwood with matte-black steel framework to craft bespoke shelving, conference tables, and floating console desks.

Kiln-Dried Seasoned CP Teak & Oak Cold-Rolled Matte Black Tubular Steel Concealed Heavy Structural Anchor Points Hardwax Natural Matte Protective Oil

Typical Applications: Suspended open kitchen shelving, boutique retail display racks, live-edge metal dining tables, entry foyer consoles, and heavy outdoor park benches.

Custom Furniture Inquiry
Chapter 05

Aluminium Work & Modular Kitchens

Engineered for high-moisture and heavy-utility zones, our custom aluminium kitchens and interior architectural profiles never swell, warp, or fall prey to termites. Fabricated with heavy-gauge structural aluminium frames, seamless high-gloss panelling, and German soft-close mechanisms for a lifetime of effortless performance.

100% Termite & Waterproof Aluminium Framing Heavy-Gauge Extruded Box Profiles Soft-Close German Hydraulic Hardware High-Gloss Acrylic & Toughened Glass Panelling Integrated Profile Handles & Custom Organizers

Typical Applications: Waterproof modular island kitchens, pantry larder units, under-sink moisture-proof cabinetry, glass-shutter display vitrines, interior sliding partitions, and slim aluminium door profiles.
